usage: eventboat [--json] replay --config <pipeline.yaml> (--dlq | --spool --from N | --job <run-id>) [--dry-run]

flags:
  -at string
    	target node for re-injection (default: each message's origin node)
  -config string
    	pipeline configuration file
  -data-dir string
    	SQLite storage directory (default "data")
  -delete
    	delete replayed dead letters after successful reinjection
  -dlq
    	replay dead letters (filtered by --since/--where)
  -dry-run
    	explain the paths instead of delivering
  -ephemeral
    	run the replay engine against an in-memory store (sinks still real)
  -from int
    	spool sequence to replay from (--spool) (default -1)
  -ids string
    	comma-separated dead letter ids to replay (--dlq)
  -job string
    	replay one job run's dead letters (run-id)
  -json
    	machine-readable output for agents and CI (the global --json, also accepted here)
  -limit int
    	maximum messages to replay (default 100)
  -since string
    	duration filter for --dlq (e.g. 2h)
  -spool
    	replay a spool window from --from <seq>
  -to int
    	spool sequence to replay through, inclusive (--spool) (default -1)
  -where string
    	CEL filter over {payload, meta} for --dlq (e.g. 'meta.region == "eu"')
